description: Defines the AWCContainerBase class, which implements the IContainer interface and provides methods for accessing container ID, memory info, processor info, and network interfaces within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: AWCContainerBase
classes.description: A class that implements the IContainer interface, representing a container with an ID and methods to access its resources.

methods.name: AWCContainerBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container with a given ID.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information for the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information for the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the network interfaces of the container.
